info.title: Kuwaiti Experience Explore API
info.description: Discovery, saved places and CMS-managed features/movies/showtimes. Public app reads select the Accept-Language request header with per-field English fallback; admin reads retain stored language fields. Schedule and ride creation are outside this API.

get.summary: Explore hub with canonical category types
Active categories with selected locale and English fallback

Published places with selected locale and English fallback
Published place in the same schema used by lists
Upcoming published sessions for a Kuwait calendar date

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter saved places by type, such as attraction, restaurant, hotel_resort, or theater. The saved-places response includes localized type tabs in data.category_types and saved records in data.places.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by the category slug returned from GET /api/v2/categories?type={type}. Omit or use all for every category.
